run_seq2seq_qa_finetune: run a seq2seq model fine-tuning script for question answering on Habana Gaudi accelerators using the HuggingFace transformers library
run_seq2seq_qa_evaluate: evaluate a fine-tuned seq2seq question answering model on a validation dataset using SQuAD metrics and beam search generation
run_seq2seq_qa_predict: run predictions with a trained seq2seq question answering model on a test dataset and save results to the output directory
create_ModelArguments: create a ModelArguments dataclass to configure the pretrained model name, tokenizer, cache directory, and revision for seq2seq QA fine-tuning
create_DataTrainingArguments: create a DataTrainingArguments dataclass to configure dataset paths, column names, max sequence length, and preprocessing options for QA training
